question: In a certain code language, TURTLE is written as RWPVJG. How will OCTOPUS be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Odd position letter of given word is -2.**

**Even position letter of given word is +2.**

TURTLE is written as RWPVJG.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4c3bc7d8d938c1b984e01de90539655b3e30423cdd05308d9b8d4e2a6b69d1a.png] 

Similarly,

OCTOPUS will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e31db5b57e309c2dba5bbc6c730643df06a9b9dc4bb443466bca6fba0f1e6efa.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MERQNWQ".**
